title: Mercedes was our tour guide, and did...
text: Mercedes was our tour guide, and did a wonderful job taking us through the Alcazar palace, and showing us the Jewish quarter. She was very kind, and allowed us to stop for water and at a sweet shop while she guided us to our Flamenco Show destination-overall a wonderful experience, highly recommend!
author: Amina F

title: Great tour of the Alcázar
text: The Alcázar itself and tour from Victoria were wonderful. The Alcázar is a must see in Seville and the tour was fun and educational. The four stars are because company’s communication and organization weren’t great. It worked out in the end, but it was stressful getting there.
author: Lindsey_W
